Input token totals do not measure requested output reservation, tool schema tokenization separately, or runtime hard-limit behavior.
No replay or larger-context controlled comparison performed; chronology alone does not identify root cause.
A terminal model response withheld by the adapter has no persisted complete ADK event; raw tool proposals/finish reason may be unavailable.
